question: Whether all current gaps/defects can be closed so an external acceptance officer can perform S4-level acceptance, and what the owner must additionally do or authorise. Or whether S4-level is impossible for us.
method: live machine truth only; no credential used; product repo not modified
headline: Not impossible. The technical blockers are dominated by one zero-credential action (git fetch + a 15-file commit) that should have been step zero. But three things are outside our authority: remote write, licence/publication scope, and the independent acceptance act itself.

measurements.repo_visibility: public (anonymous read works; no PAT needed)

working_tree_equals_r4_candidate_content.method: sha256 of the local file vs `git show origin/r4-candidate:<path>`
working_tree_equals_r4_candidate_content.conclusion: the working tree holds the R4 candidate's content on disk, but the local history is the R3 line - content-correct but unbindable, which is exactly why every publication/attestation attempt had to fail

measurements.publication_gate_mechanism: build_publication_manifest.py needs a committed subject (--commit defaults to r3-candidate); --current FAILs while any current worktree product path is UNCOVERED

closable_by_us: G2 lineage binding to cd8a06e (fetch + one 15-file commit)
owner_action_required: A1 confirm an anonymous read of the public repo satisfies the normative-source requirement
A2 authorise a writable push target + a contents:write credential, or push it themselves
A3 rule on licence / publication scope (currently non-granting LicenseRef-PIPD-Proprietary)
A4 appoint a non-Maker independent checker (whose harness the Maker did not author) for the frozen tuple
impossible_for_us_by_construction: G10 S4-level PASS itself - it is the checker's act on a frozen subject; a Maker cannot produce its own acceptance

answer.is_it_possible: Yes - not impossible. The remaining engineering is small (fetch, one commit, regenerate the publication manifest, re-run the checker on the frozen tuple).
answer.can_we_do_it_all_ourselves: No. Remote write, licence/publication scope, and the independent acceptance act are structurally outside our authority.
answer.bottleneck: the owner's four decisions, not the engineering

boundaries.claim_ceiling: FEASIBILITY_ONLY - this proves closability, not closure
must_not_be_cited_as: proof that the gaps are closed
